title: SynNet-Bench: companion code and benchmark for Generative Adversarial Networks for Network Intrusion Detection
description: Unified library and benchmark for GAN-based synthetic data in network intrusion detection: a single fit/sample interface for the models (GAN, WGAN-GP, conditional WGAN-GP, TVAE), a leakage-safe NSL-KDD data layer, a unified fidelity/utility/privacy metrics module, per-chapter companion scripts, and automated tests that fail on data leakage. Companion code to the book of the same name.
